story.iWant: to save my frequently-used filter combinations as named presets
story.soThat: I can quickly apply complex filters without re-configuring them each time
story.tasks: - Store presets in browser localStorage as JSON per tab - Format: {tab_name: [{name: "preset1", filters: {...}}, ...]} - Add preset dropdown to each tab's filter section - Use Dash callbacks to apply preset filters - Implement save, update, and delete preset functionality - Enforce maximum 10 presets per tab

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - Given I've applied filters on any dashboard tab (source, date range, category), when I click "Save Filter Preset", then I'm prompted to name the preset - And the preset is saved to browser localStorage per tab - When I return to the tab, then I see my saved presets in a dropdown - When I select a preset, then all filters are applied instantly (<300ms) - And I can update or delete existing presets

artifact.reason: Existing filter implementation with search input and dropdown that preset functionality should integrate with
Example of tab component with filter controls that will benefit from preset functionality
News tab with source and category filtering patterns for preset integration
Deal filtering implementation that preset system should support including date ranges
Main application structure where localStorage-based preset storage needs to be integrated

ecosystem.name: javascript
ecosystem.packages: localStorage API, JavaScript JSON serialization, Browser storage events

constraints.constraint: Store presets in browser localStorage with maximum 10 presets per tab to prevent storage bloat
Preset application must be instant (<300ms) to provide responsive user experience
Preset names must be unique per tab, validation for duplicate names and invalid characters
Must work across all modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) with localStorage support
Gracefully handle corrupted localStorage data and provide reset functionality

interface.name: LocalStorageManager
interface.signature: class LocalStorageManager: savePreset(tab, name, filters), loadPresets(tab), deletePreset(tab, name)

tests.standards: Client-side storage testing using Playwright to verify localStorage functionality. UI testing for preset creation, application, and deletion workflows. Cross-browser compatibility testing to ensure consistent localStorage behavior. Performance testing to verify <300ms preset application time.

ideas.idea: Test: Apply filters (source, date range, category), click "Save Filter Preset", enter preset name, and verify preset is saved to localStorage
Test: Refresh page, navigate to same tab, and verify saved presets appear in dropdown selector
Test: Select preset from dropdown and verify all filters are applied instantly with correct values
Test: Apply filters, save preset with duplicate name, and verify error handling or overwrite prompt
Test: Select existing preset, modify filters, and verify update functionality works correctly
Test: Measure time from preset selection to filter application to ensure <300ms response time
Test: Corrupt localStorage data and verify graceful recovery with default state
